THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Chocolate Protein Pumpkin Gummies

Thanksgiving pumpkin-molded chocolate protein gummies inspired by Chef Out West: grass-fed beef gelatin bloomed in cool water, gently warmed with PEScience chocolate protein, cocoa powder, monk-fruit sweetener, and vanilla, then chilled in silicone pumpkin molds. About 93 calories and 18g protein per 1/4 batch.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME10 min active + 3 hr chill
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~93 cal | ~18g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Bloom the gelatin in 2 cups cool water first, then warm gently below a boil while whisking in the protein powder, cocoa, sweetener, and vanilla so the protein does not curdle and the gelatin sets properly.

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 4 cups water, divided (2 cups cool + 2 cups cold)
  • 4 tbsp unflavored gelatin (filmed: Thrive Market Grass-Fed Beef Gelatin, 48g)
  • 1 scoop PEScience chocolate protein powder

Ingredients — continued

  • 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder (8 tbsp / ~40g)
  • 1/2 cup Whole Earth monk fruit–erythritol sweetener (24 tsp / ~96g)
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Allergens: dairy.

You want a make-ahead Thanksgiving chocolate treat that keeps in the fridge and delivers 18g protein for ~93 calories per quarter-batch.

Method

  1. 1.BLOOM THE GELATIN. Sprinkle 4 tbsp unflavored gelatin over 2 cups cool water in a saucepan and let it bloom for a few minutes.
  2. 2.WHISK & WARM GENTLY. Whisk in 1 scoop PEScience chocolate protein powder, 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/2 cup monk fruit–erythritol, and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Warm gently while whisking until smooth and fully dissolved; keep below a boil.
  3. 3.ADD COLD WATER & POUR INTO MOLDS. Stir in the remaining 2 cups cold water, then pour the mixture into silicone pumpkin molds.
  4. 4.CHILL ~3 HOURS & UNMOLD. Refrigerate for about 3 hours until completely set, then pop the chocolate pumpkins out of the silicone molds.

Keys to success

  • Because silicone mold sizes vary, macros are calculated per 1/4 of the total batch rather than per individual pumpkin.
  • Inspired by Chef Out West’s chocolate protein gummy skulls (https://thechefoutwest.com/chocolate-protein-gummy-skulls/).

Storage and reheating

Store: Store unmolded gummies in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.

Reheat: Serve chilled straight from the refrigerator; do not heat or they will melt.

Lasts: Up to 5 days refrigerated.

Estimated nutrition

~93 cal | ~18g protein per 1/4 of the batch (mold size changes total gummy count).

Estimated per 1/4 batch: ≈93 calories (rounded to ~90 on-screen), 18g protein, 30g total carbs (including ~24g erythritol), and 1.4g fat. Whole batch (4 portions): ≈372 calories, 72g protein, 121.5g total carbs, and 5.5g fat. Breakdown for full batch: 4 tbsp / 48g Thrive Market Grass-Fed Beef Gelatin (160 cal, 40g protein, 0g carbs, 0g fat; contributes 10g protein per 1/4 batch) + 1 scoop PEScience chocolate protein powder (120 cal, 24g protein, 1g carbs, 1.5g fat) + 1/2 cup / ~40g unsweetened cocoa powder (80 cal, 8g protein, 24g carbs, 4g fat using Hershey’s label reference) + 1/2 cup / ~96g Whole Earth Monk Fruit with Erythritol (0 cal, 0g protein, 96g total carbs / 96g erythritol) + 1 tsp vanilla extract (12 cal, ~0.5g carbs) + 4 cups water (0 cal).
